scenes: You are looking at a city sidewalk with a large curved planter full of red and yellow flowers, nearby trees, and parked cars along the road under a cloudy sky.

questions.question: Where is the white car?
questions.answer: The car is located on the right side of the sidewalk, about 10 meters in front of you.

goals.instruction: Move straight ahead on the paved path, keeping the planter on your left and staying in the open walking space.
As the path curves to the right near the white car, follow the curve smoothly, keeping a comfortable distance from the parked vehicles and cones.

goals.goal: Continue toward the open street area.
goals.instruction: Follow the sidewalk forward toward the intersection ahead, staying on the pedestrian path until you reach the next crossing or open walkway.

scenes: You are standing in an open paved plaza with a curved glass building on your right. Gray bollards with chains form a barrier directly ahead. A black vehicle and orange cones are to your right, with a silver car farther ahead.

questions.question: Are there any hazards in front of me?
questions.answer: You are facing short gray bollards connected by white ropes directly ahead, creating a tripping hazard. Orange traffic cones and a parked vehicle are to your right, and cars may pass through the driveway nearby.

goals.goal: Navigate safely around the barrier and cross the road.
goals.instruction: Turn 45 degrees left. Walk about 5 steps to the end of the bollards, keeping clear of the rope and posts. Pause and check for cars, then face the orange cone and walk about 10 steps forward across the driveway.

scenes: You are looking at an outdoor plaza area with wide concrete paths and multiple stairways leading upward. There are handrails along the steps, landscaped grassy areas on both sides, and tall buildings in the background.

questions.question: How do I get to the park?
questions.answer: Walk up the stairs in front of you to get to the park.

goals.instruction: Move toward the steps, place your foot firmly on each stair, and use the handrail for balance as you make your way to the upper level.
After reaching the top of the stairs, follow the wide concrete path, stay centered on the walkway, and continue in the direction of the buildings ahead.
Walk along the edge of the grassy section, stay on the paved surfaces, and follow any nearby paths that lead you through the greenery.
